name: Jürg Grossen
role: President of the Green Liberal Party of Switzerland; National Councillor for Bern
party: Green Liberal Party of Switzerland (GLP / Grünliberale)
bio: Jürg Grossen (born 24 August 1969 in Frutigen, canton of Bern) is a Swiss politician and entrepreneur. He has been a member of the National Council (Nationalrat) for the canton of Bern since 2011 and President of the Green Liberal Party of Switzerland (GLP / Grünliberale) since 26 August 2017, succeeding Martin Bäumle. Trained as an electrical planner, he is co-owner and co-managing director of Elektroplan Buchs & Grossen AG and related building-technology and smart-energy companies based in Frutigen. He sits on the National Council's Committee for Economic Affairs and Taxation (WAK-N) and is closely associated with energy, cleantech and e-mobility policy. He is married, has three children and lives in Frutigen.
